Salman Khan comments on Ranveer Singh and Ranbir Kapoor's performances

Actor Salman Khan has commented on the performances of Ranveer Singh and Ranbir Kapoor. When asked to compare Ranveer Singh's acting in 'Dhurandhar' with Ranbir Kapoor's in 'Animal', Khan stated that he had to "control his energy."
